heading: About
paragraphs: Automating things, understanding how they work, and seeing the result on an actual physical object.

C++ remains my strongest language, notably through a game engine written with my team on R-Type. Linux, the command line, Git and Docker are part of my toolkit. Backend experience adds to that: backend tech lead on Melo, my end-of-studies project.

A year in South Korea, using English every day: very comfortable speaking and reading, solid in writing. Seeking a six-month end-of-studies internship from March 2027, with a view to a permanent position.
